events.summary: S. Robson Walton joins the board (year only).
Gregory B. Penner elected at the 2008 annual meeting.
Steven S Reinemund elected at the 2010 annual meeting.
Marissa A. Mayer elected at the 2012 annual meeting.
Timothy P. Flynn appointed to the board and the Audit Committee.
C. Douglas McMillon elected to the board (CEO-designate).
McMillon becomes President and CEO.
Penner appointed to the newly created Vice Chairman position.
Thomas W. Horton appointed to the board and the Audit Committee.
Penner becomes Chairman, succeeding S. Robson Walton (Chairman since 1992), who stays on as a director.
Steuart L. Walton elected at the 2016 annual meeting.
Carla A. Harris elected at the 2017 annual meeting.
Sarah Friar appointed to the board.
Horton becomes Lead Independent Director after the 2018 annual meeting.
Cesar Conde appointed to the board.
Randall L. Stephenson appointed to the board.
Steven S Reinemund leaves at the 2022 annual meeting (did not stand; 12-year term limit).
Board reduced from 12 to 11 at the 2022 annual meeting.
S. Robson Walton leaves at the 2024 annual meeting (did not stand; retiring).
Brian Niccol elected at the 2024 annual meeting.
Robert E. Moritz, Jr. appointed to the board.
Stephenson succeeds Horton as Lead Independent Director at the 2025 annual meeting.
John R. Furner elected to the board (CEO-designate).
Shishir Mehrotra appointed to the board.
Furner succeeds McMillon as President and CEO; McMillon stays a director until the 2026 meeting.
C. Douglas McMillon's term ends at the 2026 annual meeting (not renominated; retiring).
Timothy P. Flynn's term ends at the 2026 annual meeting (not renominated; retiring).
Brian Niccol leaves at the 2026 annual meeting (did not stand).
Board set at 11 after the 2026 annual meeting. The prior size is not stated; 14 directors were serving before the meeting (11 nominees plus McMillon, Flynn and Niccol).

conflicts.description: Horton's Lead Independent Director start. The 2019-2025 proxies all say he became LID 'immediately following our 2018 Annual Shareholders' Meeting' (held 2018-05-30), and his April 2019 letter says his 'first year' as LID was closing. But his April 2025 letter says he would 'complete my sixth year' as LID, which would point to a 2019 start. Kept 2018-05-30.

How Penner and Steuart Walton are related. The 2024 proxy calls Penner 'the cousin of Steuart Walton' and Steuart Walton 'the cousin of Greg Penner'. The 2025 and 2026 proxies say Penner's spouse is Steuart Walton's cousin. The 2023-2024 proxies call Penner the son-in-law of Rob Walton and Steuart Walton his nephew; the 2008 proxy also calls Penner the son-in-law of S. Robson Walton. Both wordings are recorded as stated. The 2025-2026 wording is the more specific.

McMillon's status from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-04. The November 2025 8-K says that from February 1, 2026 he 'will continue in his capacity as an executive officer'. But the FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-03-13) does not list him among executive officers (he signs only as 'Director'), and his Forms 4 from period 2026-01-31 on check only the director box. No executive_director role is recorded for that stretch. He stays a non-independent (employee) director until 2026-06-04.

Form 4 relationship boxes lag board events. Furner's Forms 4 for January 2026 (e.g., period 2026-01-15) check only the officer box although he joined the board on 2025-11-13 (8-K). His Forms 4 from period 2026-01-31 on check both boxes. Board dates follow the 8-K.

Penner's prior-board dates differ between proxies. Hyatt start is 'October 2007' in the 2019-2021 proxies and 'August 2007' in the 2025-2026 proxies. Baidu end is 'February 2017' in the 2019 proxy and 'December 2017' from 2020 on. Recorded the 2026 proxy's dates.

open_questions: Exact days Penner became Vice Chairman (June 2014) and Chairman (June 2015). Filings give only the month. Both likely coincide with the annual meetings, but no filing says so. Month precision kept.
S. Robson Walton's 1978 board start. It predates EDGAR and no filing gives a month or day. Year precision.
Who chairs the Executive Committee after McMillon left on 2026-06-04? Not disclosed in any filing through 2026-10-02.

Committee assignments after the 2026 annual meeting are disclosed only for Moritz (Audit Chair, effective upon his re-election). Who replaced Flynn and Niccol on Audit, TeCC and CMDC is not disclosed. The committee rows are a snapshot as of the 2026 proxy (2026-04-23).

The NYSE listing year (often cited as 1972) is not stated in any filing found; EDGAR full-text search covers 2001+. listed_since_year=1970 rests on the 10-K statement that the IPO was completed in 1970.
Mayer's board service is extended only until the 2027 annual meeting. Expect a departure at that meeting, but it is not yet an event.
Pre-2020 directors who left before 2020-01-01 are not recorded (e.g., Stephen J. Easterbrook, who resigned 2019-11-04; James I. Cash, Jr. and Kevin Y. Systrom, who did not stand in 2018).

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A (11 nominees) and the 2026-06-05 Item 5.07 8-K (all 11 elected). Every 8-K with Item 5.02 filed after the proxy was reviewed; none exists through 2026-10-02, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed. Every 2026 Form 3/4 owner was parsed: all 11 directors filed Forms 4 as directors after the meeting (10 in June 2026, then 9 outside directors on 2026-10-02, Horton on 2026-06-08, Furner on 2026-09-18), and no new director Form 3 was filed after 2026-01-12.

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed. Nominee slates compared year over year (2019: 12, 2020: 11, 2021: 12, 2022: 11, 2023: 11, 2024: 11, 2025: 12, 2026: 11) and reconciled to appointments and departures. Every director Form 3 since 2019 was checked. Departures are dated from the Item 5.07 meeting date for directors not renominated.

Pre-2020 seats recorded only for directors serving on or after 2020-01-01. Reconstructed from proxies, appointment 8-Ks, Item 5.07 8-Ks and director Forms 3. Directors who left before 2020 are not recorded.
